text_block_list.text:
I thought I heard someone call for me... 
Did they get too shy and go home?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The statue of the Three Goddesses...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm here, maybe I'll take a photo 
with the Goddesses and post it♪
